g.title: BATT_POS
g.text: Dedicated 60A Maxi fuse (supplied with kit) within a few inches of the battery terminal, separate from MAIN_FUSE in power-distribution.wv. 10 AWG minimum per vendor spec.

g.title: CABLE_ECU_PWR_POS
g.text: Battery +12V (via 60A Maxi fuse) to Steering ECU receptacle C (black power plug). 10 AWG minimum per vendor spec. Route from engine bay battery location through firewall to under-dash ECU mount.

g.title: STEERING_ECU
g.text: Mount to bare metal as heat sink -- do not fully enclose
Receptacle D/E -- motor bundle 1 (blue + grey plugs)
Receptacle D/E -- motor bundle 2 (blue + grey plugs)

Receptacle C: red to +12V battery (60A Maxi fuse), black to GND. 10 AWG or larger per vendor spec. Receptacles D (blue, motor power) and E (grey 4-pin, motor position/torque sensor) are vendor pre-terminated to MOTOR_ASSEMBLY as a bundled umbilical -- no user pinout, just mate the factory plugs. Modeled here as 2 logical pins since the internal pin count is not published. Calibration potentiometer under the round cover hole (left/right effort balance) -- separate from the driver Adjustment Knob. Single relay click on IGN-on is normal; a double-click indicates a wiring or connection fault.

g.title: CHASSIS_GND
g.text: Vendor recommends the closest chassis ground point to the Steering ECU mounting location, sanded to bare metal for good contact. 10 AWG minimum for the ECU power ground; 18-20 AWG acceptable for the EPS Controller signal ground (separate run, see CABLE_CTRL_GND).

g.title: CABLE_ECU_PWR_GND
g.text: GND to Steering ECU receptacle C (black power plug). 10 AWG minimum per vendor spec.

g.title: EPS_CONTROLLER
g.text: Small inline box -- sets fixed assist level via Adjustment Knob
Plug A -- pink (to Steering ECU receptacle B)
Plug A -- purple (to Steering ECU receptacle B)

No vehicle-speed or CAN input exists on this controller -- assist level is fixed by the Adjustment Knob position only, not by road speed. Red wire: IGN-switched +12V via 10A Mini ATM fuse (supplied). Black wire: nearest chassis ground. Mount where accessible for wiring but does not need to be driver-visible.

g.title: CABLE_CTRL_LINK
g.text: EPS_CONTROLLER:3:Plug A -- pink (to Steering ECU receptacle B)
EPS_CONTROLLER:4:Plug A -- purple (to Steering ECU receptacle B)
Plug A (pink/purple pair) -- EPS Controller to Steering ECU receptacle B. Pre-terminated on both ends by the vendor; this run only applies if extending the supplied cable length.

g.title: CABLE_CTRL_GND
g.text: EPS Controller black wire to nearest chassis ground point.

g.title: IGN_12V_TAP
g.text: M5x Phase 1: relay board IGN output | 07K Phase 3: PMU16 O8

10A Mini ATM fuse (supplied with kit) protects this feed specifically for the EPS Controller -- independent of the 60A Maxi fuse on the Steering ECU's main battery feed. M5x Phase 1: tap the relay board IGN-switched output (the same +12V rail used for fuel pump / fan relay coil pin 86 in maxxecu-m52.wv), or use a fuse-tap on an OEM IGN circuit from the body harness. No additional relay is needed -- just fuse this feed with the supplied 10A Mini ATM. 07K Phase 3: at PMU16 installation, move this one wire end from the relay board to PMU16 O8 (10A digital channel, power-distribution.wv spare output). PMU16 per-channel fusing replaces the discrete 10A ATM at that stage.

g.title: CABLE_CTRL_PWR
g.text: EPS Controller red wire to IGN-switched +12V via 10A Mini ATM fuse (supplied with kit). Independent circuit from the Steering ECU's 60A main power feed.

g.title: ADJUSTMENT_KNOB
g.text: Fully counter-clockwise = no assist. Fully clockwise = maximum assist. Mount within reach of the driver -- for this RHD car, place on the right-hand side of the dash/console (vendor reference photos assume LHD placement on the left). Calibrate per vendor Basic System Verification procedure: knob full CCW, IGN on (single relay click), wait ~10s for relay to click off (no assist), then slowly turn CW until relay clicks back on -- that is minimum assist. Continue CW to taste.

g.title: CABLE_KNOB
g.text: Adjustment Knob (yellow + gray) to EPS Controller (yellow + gray). Route from dash-mounted knob to controller box location. Low current signal pair -- no special shielding required.

g.title: MOTOR_ASSEMBLY
g.text: EPowerSteering column-mounted EPS motor (KIT-33, non-tilt or tilt per order)
Bolts to repurposed steering column, replaces mechanical column internals
Blue plug (power -- to Steering ECU receptacle D)
Grey 4-pin plug (position/torque sensor -- to Steering ECU)

Pre-terminated at the factory as part of the core-exchange rebuild -- no user pinout published or required. Just mate the factory plugs. Column mounts under the dash in place of the stock column; output shaft couples to the existing lower steering shaft / Condor Speed Shop slim RHD shaft (see project plan Steering Shaft row).

g.title: CABLE_MOTOR_LINK
g.text: MOTOR_ASSEMBLY:1:Blue plug (power -- to Steering ECU receptacle D)
STEERING_ECU:5:Receptacle D/E -- motor bundle 1 (blue + grey plugs)
MOTOR_ASSEMBLY:2:Grey 4-pin plug (position/torque sensor -- to Steering ECU)
STEERING_ECU:6:Receptacle D/E -- motor bundle 2 (blue + grey plugs)

Blue power plug + grey 4-pin sensor plug bundled together as a single vendor-supplied umbilical between the Motor Assembly (on the column, under the dash) and the Steering ECU. Pre-terminated -- no fabrication or re-pinning, just mate the factory connectors. Gauge shown is nominal/placeholder only -- actual conductors are factory-terminated and not user-serviceable.
